entry.title: Akershus Fortress

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected aerial picture confirms two clock spires, open castle court, stepped gables and mixed stone/brick wings. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained castle footprint establish approximate coastal location and east/south orientation. A reconstructed8m datum reduction places the original12m court at4m above the PMTiles anchor sample; bounded stone terrace/foundation bottoms extend to coarse ground. Broad invented lower lawn terrain and study pond surfaces are omitted so host terrain supplies the lower precinct. Wider building/bastion layout remains approximate. Anchor 10.736251164,59.906686713; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 21.632957278541383m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
